english.title: Disclose information obtained in a factory / workplace with regard to a manufacturing process / trade secret
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been admitted into a

(A)_[factory]_
(B)_[workplace]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) in compliance with

(C)_[section 95]_
(D)_[a warrant issued under section 95]_

of the Building Act 1984, disclosed to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) information obtained by you in that

(E)_[factory]_
(F)_[workplace]_

with regard to a

(G)_[manufacturing process]_
(H)_[trade secret]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(3) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person admitted into factory / workplace
in compliance with s 95 Building Act 1984 / warrant under that section
disclosed to another information
obtained in the factory / workplace
re manufacturing process / trade secret

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This is not an offence if the disclosure is made in the performance of the defendant's duty
